primaryCauses: Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) deficiency during early brooder stage.
remediationNotes: Supplement with brewer's yeast, dairy byproducts, or synthetic riboflavin in water immediately.

primaryCauses: Manganese or Choline deficiency leading to hock joint enlargement and tendon slippage.
remediationNotes: Ensure manganese sulfate levels meet minimum requirements; add wheat bran or choline supplements.

primaryCauses: Inadequate dietary Calcium, unbuffered Calcium:Phosphorus ratio, or Vitamin D3 deficiency.
remediationNotes: Provide free-choice coarse oyster shell or limestone grit; verify Vitamin D3 levels.

primaryCauses: Niacin (Vitamin B3) deficiency during rapid waterfowl skeletal development.
remediationNotes: Supplement waterfowl feed with 55-70 mg/kg Niacin or brewer's yeast. Standard chicken starter is insufficient.

primaryCauses: Deficiency in sulfur-containing amino acids (Methionine/Cystine) or low dietary Crude Protein/Sodium.
remediationNotes: Increase synthetic Methionine or high-protein meals (e.g., sunflower meal, fish meal); check salt levels.

primaryCauses: Vitamin E deficiency or rancid dietary fats oxidizing Vitamin E stores.
remediationNotes: Add Tocopherol / Vitamin E supplements and evaluate feed storage age to prevent fatty oxidation.

primaryCauses: Vitamin A deficiency causing squamous metaplasia of respiratory mucosa.
remediationNotes: Incorporate green forage, alfalfa meal, or stabilized Vitamin A premix.
